hits.last: Which is the single smartest thing anybody on this street is doing.
hits.full: It is not coming off the mains at all. Whoever built that is using the same water twice and the yard is the second use. Which is the single smartest thing anybody on this street is doing.

hits.speaker: owner
hits.last: You are the first one to use the gate.
hits.full: Four months. Four months of people slowing down at my fence and speeding up when I come out. You are the first one to use the gate.

hits.speaker: owner
hits.last: It is just not YOURS.
hits.full: Nobody asked. They did the sum instead. And the sum is right, that is the thing that has been killing me. It IS a hundred and ten thousand gallons. It is just not YOURS.

hits.speaker: neighbour
hits.last: That is a bell you cannot un-ring on a corner lot.
hits.full: You want it in front of everyone. All right. That is a bell you cannot un-ring on a corner lot.

hits.speaker: nurse
hits.last: Look at where they are before you look at anything else.
hits.full: Here is the list. Look at where they are before you look at anything else.

hits.speaker: nurse
hits.last: Whatever this is, it did not care that we were cleaning the tank.
hits.full: Two more houses went bad while we were in there. Whatever this is, it did not care that we were cleaning the tank.

hits.speaker: fitter
hits.last: Up the hill, if that is where the pipe goes.
hits.full: Take the pressure off and every place where somebody has joined something to that pipe stops being an outlet and becomes an inlet. It sucks. Backward. Up the hill, if that is where the pipe goes.

hits.speaker: fitter
hits.last: There is a street full of people being sensible one at a time.
hits.full: There is no villain in this. There is a street full of people being sensible one at a time.

hits.speaker: pumper
hits.last: What is that face.
hits.full: What. What is that face.

hits.speaker: pumper
hits.last: It is not doing anything.
hits.full: It has been in there a month. It is a hose in a barrel. It is not doing anything.

hits.speaker: pumper
hits.last: Is that what you are about to tell me.
hits.full: ...It is not doing anything when the pressure is up. Is that what you are about to tell me.

hits.speaker: fitter
hits.last: You do not wait for proof to stop drinking.
hits.full: They will hate it and about a third of them will not do it, and it is still the right call before you know whose connection it is. That is exactly what a precautionary notice is FOR. You do not wait for proof to stop drinking.

hits.speaker: mother
hits.book: What The Cold Did Not Kill
hits.last: And it is the first offer anybody has made me that costs THEM something.
hits.full: That is not nothing you are asking. That is more than half of what is between her and finding out the hard way. And it is the first offer anybody has made me that costs THEM something.

hits.speaker: lineman
hits.last: It just IS, every morning, exactly as it was.
hits.full: So I watched. Nobody collects. Nobody adjusts. There is no meeting where it gets decided. It just IS, every morning, exactly as it was.

hits.speaker: clerk
hits.last: Nobody locked it because nobody wanted anything in it.
hits.full: You found it open. Nobody locked it because nobody wanted anything in it.

hits.speaker: clerk
hits.last: The end date printed on it is 2067.
hits.full: Signed in October. Runs fifty years. The end date printed on it is 2067.

hits.speaker: clerk
hits.last: It is paper.
hits.full: You can. It is paper.
